query: raise MAX_ITEMS from 50 to 200, changing nothing else
check: grep -q 'MAX_ITEMS = 200' $FILE && ! grep -q 'MAX_ITEMS = 50' $FILE && grep -q 'public Order create' $FILE && grep -q 'OrderStatus.CANCELLED' $FILE

query: add a public method 'long count()' that returns repository.count(), placed after findById, keeping every existing method
check: grep -q 'long count()' $FILE && grep -q 'repository.count()' $FILE && grep -q 'public Optional<Order> findById' $FILE && grep -q 'public void cancel' $FILE

query: change the exception message from 'too many items' to 'order exceeds the maximum line count', leaving the throw and the condition alone
check: grep -q 'order exceeds the maximum line count' $FILE && ! grep -q 'too many items' $FILE && grep -q 'IllegalArgumentException' $FILE && grep -q 'lines.size() > MAX_ITEMS' $FILE
